headline: SB police officer beaten to death in Aminbazar
summary: A Special Branch (SB) officer, identified as Md. Altab Hossain, is killed by a mob in the Bordeshi area of Aminbazar, Savar.
details: A member of the Special Branch (SB) of the Bangladesh Police, identified as Md. Altab Hossain, was beaten to death by a mob in the Bordeshi area of Aminbazar, Savar, on the night of September 5.
The victim's son, who was also beaten by the attackers, was the sole witness to the attack. He stated that the attackers were drug addicts who frequently use drugs in the local same area.
Following the investigation, the 'mastermind' of the attack has been arrested by the police.
The incident has sparked tension in the local community as authorities work to identify and other suspects involved in the attack.
caption:
A Special Branch police officer was beaten to death in Savar.

A member of the Special Branch (SB) of the Bangladesh Police, identified as Md. Altab Hossain, was beaten to death by a mob in the Bordeshi area of Aminbazar, Savar, on the night of September 5.

The victim's son, who was also beaten by the attackers, was the sole witness to the attack. He stated that the attackers were drug addicts who frequently use drugs in the local same area.

Following the investigation, the 'mastermind' of the attack has been arrested by the police.

The incident has sparked tension in the local community as authorities work to identify and other suspects involved in the attack.

headline_marked: Over 2,500kg of [[gold seized from smugglers]] between 2010 and 2024
headline: Over 2,500kg of gold seized from smugglers between 2010 and 2024
summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury revealed the massive haul of precious metals confiscated by authorities over the last 14 years.
details: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury informed the parliament today that a total of 2,518.66kg of gold were seized from smugglers between 2010 and 2024.
The disclosure came during a question-and-answer session at the Jatiya Sangsad this afternoon, in response to a query from MP Farida Yasmin.
MP Farida Yasmin had specifically asked about the quantity of gold, gold bars, and other metal items confiscated from smugglers during this period.
In addition to the gold, the Finance Minister revealed that 377.39kg of silver was also seized from smugglers between 2010 and 2024.
caption:
Over 2.5 tonnes of gold seized in 14 years.

Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury informed the parliament today that a total of 2,518.66kg of gold were seized from smugglers between 2010 and 2024.

The disclosure came during a question-and-answer session at the Jatiya Sangsad this afternoon, in response to a query from MP Farida Yasmin.

MP Farida Yasmin had specifically asked about the quantity of gold, gold bars, and other metal items confiscated from smugglers during this period.

In addition to the gold, the Finance Minister revealed that 377.39kg of silver was also seized from smugglers between 2010 and 2024.
